title: Asyncio Concurrent HTTP Fetcher (httpx)
description: Fetch dozens of API URLs concurrently using httpx.AsyncClient and asyncio.gather.
codeContent:
import asyncio, httpx

async def fetch_all(urls: list[str]):
    async with httpx.AsyncClient(timeout=10.0) as client:
        tasks = [client.get(u) for u in urls]
        return await asyncio.gather(*tasks, return_exceptions=True)

title: Python Context Manager for Timing
description: Measure execution latency of any code block using @contextmanager.
codeContent:
import time
from contextlib import contextmanager

@contextmanager
def timer(label="block"):
    t0 = time.perf_counter()
    try: yield
    finally: print(f"{label}: {(time.perf_counter() - t0)*1000:.2f} ms")
